notes: Source PDF lists members under headings: 'N.W.F.P-26', 'THE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREA (FATA-8)', 'FEDERAL CAPITAL-01', 'THE PUNJAB', 'SINDH PROVINCE-46', then seats 197-207 (Quetta through Turbat-cum-Panjgur), which are Balochistan constituencies, but the extracted text did not preserve an explicit 'BALUCHISTAN' section-heading line before them (likely lost in PDF text extraction) - province for NA-197 to NA-207 was inferred from the well-known constituency names, not invented.
General/constituency seats: 207 total (NA-1 to NA-207), all filled (no 'Vacant' entries appear in this assembly's constituency list).

Seat NA-134 (Rajanpur-I) is printed in the source without its 'NA-' prefix ('134. Rajanpur-I ...'); the seat code NA-134 was inferred from the sequential S.No column, consistent with the numbering immediately before/after it.

Non-Muslim members: heading reads 'LIST OF NON-MUSLIM MEMBERS IN THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY  TOTAL-10'. Exactly 10 members listed (Sr. 208-217), grouped by a 'Community' column: Christian (4), Hindu/Scheduled Castes (4), Parsi/Sikh/Budhists and others (1), Ahmadi (1). Per project context, these were directly/separately elected on nationwide non-Muslim separate electorates rather than list-allocated, so elected_via is recorded as 'general' rather than 'indirect' or 'nominated'.

Women members: heading reads 'WOMEN MEMBERS-2' (the '-2' appears to be an OCR/layout artifact, not an actual count of 2 - the section in fact lists 22 named women across sub-headings 'N.W.F.P-2' (2 names), 'PUNJAB-12' (12 names), 'SINDH-04' (4 names), 'BALUCHISTAN-02' (2 names, Sr. 236-237), followed by a further, apparently duplicate/mis-numbered sub-block also labelled 'BALUCHISTAN-01' containing 2 more names numbered Sr. 235-236 (reusing serial numbers already used earlier in the Sindh/Balochistan-02 blocks). This numbering collision is transcribed exactly as printed and was not corrected. All 22 named women appear as members here.

The source PDF gives no constituency/seat number for reserved women's seats or non-Muslim seats (only province/community groupings), so 'seat' is null for those records. elected_via for women's reserved seats is recorded as 'indirect', reflecting the pre-1988-lapse constitutional mechanism (election by the assembly's own electoral college) noted in the task context - this is a contextual inference, not a statement in the PDF itself.

OCR artifacts: the raw extracted text contained many stray mid-word spaces (e.g. 'Moham m ad', 'Haj i', 'I qbal'); these have been collapsed to normal spelling ('Mohammad', 'Haji', 'Iqbal') per instructions, with no other spelling changes made.

REVIEW FLAG: 22 reserved_women transcribed against the era's 20-seat allocation (Punjab 12, Sindh 4, KP 2, Balochistan 4). Names are distinct, so these are likely replacements — but the final two Balochistan entries (Begum Bilqees Shahbaz, Dr. Miss Noor Jehan Panezai) are the same pair listed in the 7th Assembly PDF and reuse serial numbers 235-236, so possible source-layout leakage. Unverified; not resolved.
